title: Repair dev paper Source schedule prerequisite before final release health without inventing authority
objective: Repair lawful dev paper Source schedule prerequisite before final release health without inventing authority or patching binding/approval.

owned: services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: Added _is_operator_stopped(connector) helper distinguishing explicit operator stops from controller-managed retirement (retired_by_authoritative_snapshot).

services/source_ingestion/routers/ingest_operations.py: Enforced PUT /api/source-ingest/connectors/{connector_id}/schedule fails closed with HTTP 400 when an explicit operator stop is active on the connector.
services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py: Updated run_scheduled_pipeline to fail closed and report explicit operator stop when exclusively selected connector is stopped.
services/source_ingestion/tests/test_scheduler.py: Added tests verifying disabled schedule fails closed, temporary admission and restoration on success, and operator stop preservation.

services/source_ingestion/tests/test_latest_market_snapshot_state.py: Added test_stored_marketless_spy_snapshot_becomes_market_bearing_and_admits_producer proving stored marketless SPY snapshot transitions to market: 'US' via registered Source adapter authority and admits PaperSignalProducer.

scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh: Updated stage_dev_paper_prerequisite_readiness with operator stop preservation, prior schedule query, bounded temporary schedule admission (PUT /schedule with controller token), run-scheduled execution, and guaranteed restoration trap on success/failure/exit.
scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py: Added unit tests verifying schedule admission and restoration on success, restoration on refresh failure, and operator stop preservation.

scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: Enforced market context in ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready with non-progressing clock iteration guard and AssertionError propagation, accepted and forwarded force_connector_ids and exclusive_connector_ids in _nudge_run_scheduled, updated self-test valid_snapshot, and added self-tests for missing market and nudge forwarding.
scripts/test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: Updated test snapshot fixtures to include market context and aligned test expectations with market-bearing snapshot requirements.
not_changing: Historical bindings, receipts, and NULL-tenant historical evidence preserved without relabeling.
No production, live trading, or capital-affecting changes; paper-only fences and zero real capital guarantees remain intact.
No bypass of release lease gates or provider health checks.
composes_with: Persona provisioning and paper fleet baseline bootstrap in scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py.
Release deployment workflow in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh stage_dev_paper_prerequisite_readiness.
Source Ingestion scheduler and market snapshot store.

implementation.root_cause: Release 37604190265 failed in Phase 4 of deploy_nonprod_vm.sh at stage_dev_paper_prerequisite_readiness. PR #6282 passed force_connector_ids and exclusive_connector_ids for dev-paper-us-equity-simulation to run-scheduled, but connector_schedule.jsonl on the host had dev-paper-us-equity-simulation set to enabled: false. pipeline.py failed closed reporting 'exclusively selected connector schedule is disabled', causing deploy_nonprod_vm.sh to classify the outcome as 'controller mode refuses refresh' and abort before baseline bootstrap could run.
implementation.solution: Implemented lawful bounded temporary schedule admission: (1) Check GET /connectors/{id} for explicit operator stop and fail closed if stopped; (2) Query GET /connectors/{id}/schedule to record prior enabled and interval; (3) If disabled, temporarily enable via authenticated PUT /schedule with controller bearer token; (4) Set an exit/INT/TERM trap to ensure restoration of prior schedule state on both success and failure; (5) Trigger run-scheduled and verify snapshot becomes market-bearing ('US') before proceeding; (6) Restore prior schedule state on all exit paths.
